Confidential

Soundtracking two evenings – September 3rd and 7th, from 7–8.30pm – with an intimate, elegant musical moment for the couple and their guests as they enjoy sunset cocktails at Hotel du Cap’s Grill Restaurant.

The creative direction is refined, timeless and effortlessly sophisticated – music that complements this special celebration and their longstanding connection to the hotel, rather than taking over the room. We’ve curated exceptional artists with a repertoire spanning much-loved favourites and French classics, each chosen to bring warmth, character and a little Riviera magic to the evening.

Artists

  • Flexible line-ups: Solo, duo or trio formats available depending on the artist and desired feel.
  • Styling: Artists can be styled to complement the event aesthetic and dress code.
  • Repertoire: Artists have extensive, adaptable repertoires, with additional tracks available on request, subject to suitability, fee and preparation time.
  • Set-up: Acoustic and minimal set-ups available where appropriate, keeping the presentation discreet and self contained.
  • Roaming: Where appropriate, artists can perform roaming, moving naturally through the space rather than from a fixed position.

Proposal Terms

  • This proposal and any recommendations shared are exclusively for the purpose of evaluating entertainment options for this event.
  • The proposal may be shared internally for planning purposes, but should not be shared externally with artists, agencies or unrelated third parties.
  • Any artists or suppliers introduced or recommended by Miro Sounds, whether within this proposal or otherwise, must be booked through Miro Sounds unless otherwise agreed in writing.
  • If an artist or supplier introduced by Miro Sounds is subsequently approached or booked directly, Miro Sounds reserves the right to charge an appropriate fee.

About Us

We curate and coordinate exceptional music for unforgettable events. From the familiar to the fresh, the refined to the raw, we find the perfect pairing of sound and setting for every occasion.

Drawing on 15 years of experience across music, events and sound curation, we work with a trusted global network of artists, sourcing and handpicking the right talent for each event – without the limitations of a fixed roster, ensuring every experience feels genuinely tailored.

Tell us your vision and we’ll take it from there; from initial consultation and creative direction through to artist curation, booking and logistics, we take care of every detail behind the scenes.
